model_annotation:
The image presents four pie charts, each representing the distribution of language model's answer refusal categories on a specific model. The charts are labeled as follows: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. 

The GPT4-o chart displays two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" accounting for approximately 83.3% and colored red, while "Safety" accounts for around 16.7% and is colored orange. A legend is not present, but percentage labels are displayed inside the slices. 

The Gemini1.5-Pro chart consists of five slices: "Misinformation" (38.4%, orange), "Clarification" (14.0%, yellow), "Ethical Advice" (16.3%, blue), "Lack of Knowledge" (22.1%, dark blue), and "Safety" (9.3%, light blue). 

The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" making up about 75.0% (orange) and "Clarification" making up 25.0% (red). 

The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also comprises two slices, with both "Misinformation" and "Lack of Knowledge" accounting for 50.0% each, colored red and orange respectively. No chart has visually emphasized slices, and the segments do not appear to be ordered in any particular way.
